name: 4 Priests Mind Control
description: A deliberately small 4-Priest board that runs fewer pieces than its capacity so every priest mind-controls an enemy unit each round, using Witless Shako to steal higher-level targets and Luna as the lone damage dealer. Sourced from the YouTube guide 'How To Play 3-Star PRIESTS In Dota Auto Chess' (youtube.com/watch?v=uFXo8FdNDdw).

snapshots.label: Final board
snapshots.focusNote: Board is kept under capacity so the 4-Priest bond hijacks three enemy units per round; Witless Shako on the highest-level priest (Chen) lets it steal tier-four and neutral targets, priests are spread out to dodge Riki smoke, and Luna carries the actual damage.
